description: The opening title card over the first shots: whether it shows, its DESIGN (the same designs as the Text panel's design buttons; browse_options title_designs shows what each looks like), WHICH WORDS it shows (the address, or the listing name, like the Text panel's Address / Listing name switch), which listing facts it shows (price, bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet) and its background. The words come from Property details, as in the Studio: for a title like 'Just Listed in Austin', update_property_details sets the listing name and wording listing_name here shows it. The address itself is changed in Property details. The result says exactly what visibly changed, or why nothing did.

background.description: Glass (frosted) or plain background, or none. Only designs with a background.

design.description: Design id. browse_options title_designs gives each design's name and what it looks like.

enabled.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the opening title.

show.description: Facts to show (true) or hide (false). Omitted facts stay as they are.

baths.description: Show the bathroom count on the title.

beds.description: Show the bedroom count on the title.

price.description: Show the price on the title.

sqft.description: Show the square feet on the title.

wording.description: Show the street address, or the listing name from Property details.

name: set_title
title: Opening title
